description: The agent must: (1) Read the conversation transcript at clients/active/CLI-2024-089_transcript.txt to extract the client profile: female, game use (王者荣耀), style preference for both 文艺清冷 AND 游戏竞技, name is 陈晓雨 (loves rain and moon imagery). (2) Consult the SKILL.md to discover the exact proprietary output format — NOT the deprecated template in templates/styles/output_template_v1.md. (3) Produce nickname_report.md with: the 🎭 header emoji, exactly 3-5 bold-formatted nicknames (**name**), each followed by a 💬 创意解读：section with meaningful explanation. (4) The nicknames must reflect the dual style (文艺清冷 + 游戏竞技) and incorporate the client's personal imagery (雨/月/晓 characters from her name and stated preferences). (5) Apply creative techniques from SKILL.md (拆解重组 using her name characters, 意象联想 for rain/moon, 文化引用 optional). The key proprietary trap: agents without reading SKILL.md will miss the 🎭/💬 emoji markers, the bold markdown requirement for names, the 3-5 count limit, and the mandatory 创意解读 per nickname. They may also fall into the deprecated format trap in the old template file.
